security.heading: Devices and app credentials
security.caption: Manage browser sessions and personal Git/OAuth access
security.loadFailed: Devices or app credentials are temporarily unavailable. Try again.
security.verificationStartFailed: Could not start security verification. Try again.
security.operationFailed: The operation is not confirmed complete. Retry and check the remote status.
security.operationAccepted: The operation is confirmed and the list reflects remote state.
security.signedOutComplete: Revocation is confirmed. Sign in again on this device.

devices.heading: Browser devices
devices.detail: Each device has an independent session. Signing out one device leaves other devices and personal SSH, PAT, and OAuth credentials active.

credentials.heading: Personal app credentials
credentials.detail: Only metadata for personal SSH, PAT, and OAuth access from Gitea and the inner world is shown. Secrets are never displayed.
credentials.revokeAllImpact: Revoking all personal access also signs out every browser device. Repository content, workspaces, deploy keys, and service accounts remain intact.

verification.caption: Recent verification
verification.detail: Enter the phone used by this CloudBase account to receive a code and confirm this action.

recovery.heading: Editor recovery
recovery.caption: Uncommitted work and Git recovery packages
recovery.detail: Recovery packages are separate from Git commits and publishing. They include a tracked patch, untracked files, an unpushed commit bundle, and Git status. Download links expire quickly.
recovery.empty: No editor recovery packages are available.
recovery.downloadFailed: Could not create a recovery download link.
